title: Independent Set by width of a supplied rank decomposition
task: Does G have at least k pairwise nonadjacent vertices?
encoding: A finite, simple, undirected, unweighted graph G and a nonnegative integer k.
parameter: The actual width of the supplied rank decomposition, denoted by p. Cut rank is computed over the binary field.
coverage: Historical ETH and independently reviewed recoveries.

sourceBasis.step: On a 3-CNF formula with s variables plus clauses, the reduction and false-twin expansion take 2^{O(√s)} time up to a polynomial factor and construct a vertex order of width O(√s). Place the leaves in that order along a caterpillar to obtain the supplied rank decomposition. Substituting this width gives a fixed power saving in the exponent for 3-SAT.

recoveryAssessments.comparison: The clock has the historical squared-width scale with a computable exponent and modulus. The normalized graph encoding, including any supplied certificate, is polynomial in the graph order.

For every fixed positive exponent saving below two, the recovery excludes the corresponding power of the same width. The normalized graph encoding, including any supplied certificate, is polynomial in the graph order.
